title: Its Own Rook
setup: Black has just slid a rook across to g8, and every square beside its king is now occupied.
hint: Before you hunt for a check, count how many empty squares the black king could actually move to.
explanation:
## The Idea

The king on h8 is walled in by its own rook and its own pawns, so a check it cannot capture is mate. A knight could check from g6, but the h-pawn would take it; {{Nf7#}} checks from the square no black piece covers. When a king is boxed in, stop counting material and start counting checks.
